title: Compact query builder + embeddings inspector: component library & Figma variant mapping
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact, reusable component set and variant mapping in Figma for the query builder control and an 'Embeddings Inspector' panel used on cost & diagnostics dashboards. Deliver a tokens-first spec (spacing, elevation, color states, motion) and a complete mapping between design variants and React props so engineering can implement a single, accessible component library across Hosted/Dedicated/Private console surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library with components: CompactQueryInput, QueryChips, SuggestionRail, EmbeddingsInspectorPanel, VectorResultRow
Variant mapping document linking each Figma variant to prop names (size, density, tone, state) stored in drive:design/Query-Embeddings-VariantMap.md
Accessible keyboard + screen reader behavior described for each component (aria roles, focus order, live region usage)
Token table (spacing, elevation, color tokens, motion timings) exported as CSV and included in Figma variables
Engineering handoff with storybook-compatible props and 1 reference PR: github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/3456
decisions: Adopt a 'compact' density option based on 8px baseline with -2 vertical padding for list rows to save vertical real estate on dashboards
Use elevation token E1 (subtle stroke + 1px shadow) for inspector panels instead of heavy box-shadows to reduce GPU cost on low-end devices
Expose 'tone' prop with values neutral / success / warning for chip states; map to existing console color tokens to maintain consistency
Motion durations standardized to 120ms (micro interactions) and 280ms (panel open/close) to match console rhythms
review_comments: Elena Rivera (PM): Please ensure the QueryChips support selectable multi-state and reflect cost-estimate badges — linked designs updated 2026-03-02
Marcus Liu (Eng): Variant mapping looks good; request: include explicit prop for 'prefers-reduced-motion' fallback and a CSS-only focus ring option for legacy environments
Priya Patel (Accessibility): Confirmed color contrast for all chip states; recommended stronger focus indicators for compact density in 14px text sizes
DesignOps (Liam O'Connor): Suggest extracting VectorResultRow into a shared primitive to reuse in embeddings diagnostics and reranking views
implementation_notes: Provide a CSV export of Figma variables and a JSON props map for frontend (location: drive/design/exports/query-embeddings-tokens.csv)
Add a Storybook story per variant and a visual test snapshot for compact density
Create a small migration guide for existing usages of large QueryInput to map to new CompactQueryInput props
usability_findings: Moderated sessions (n=6) showed 85% completion for constructing multi-filter queries in under 42s using keyboard-first flows
Participants preferred inline cost-estimate badges on chips vs a floating tooltip when working on laptops with constrained vertical space
Embeddings Inspector's 'vector preview' was confusing; added a contextual label and simplified axis markers per feedback
next_steps: Finalize Figma variable export and upload CSV to drive by 2026-03-16
Resolve Marcus's engineering requests and update variant mapping document by 2026-03-18
Create first implementation PR and link in ticket when ready (target 2026-03-20)
Schedule a 30-min cross-functional review with Eng (Marcus), PM (Elena), and Accessibility (Priya) 2026-03-17
notes: This ticket attempts to balance dense information display with accessibility — tradeoffs are documented in the Confluence page
Keep the component API minimal: prefer boolean density props (compact: true) over multiple size enums to reduce prop combinatorics
For Private console skinning, provide token overrides rather than separate components
